integrity: The proof normalizes two adjacent uniquely selecting width directions to a lattice basis, derives a two-parameter symmetric quadrilateral normal form, and proves that unequal parameters leave only one parallel pair of shortest lattice directions, contradicting completeness. A dependency-free exact-arithmetic checker stress-tests the gauge, polar map, and invariant formulas; finite checks are not used as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to origin-symmetric planar quadrilaterals. It does not classify non-symmetric quadrilaterals or higher-vertex polygons. The exact polar, area, and diameter formulas are consequences of the canonical classification. The full 2001 Barany-Furedi paper was not accessible for a theorem-by-theorem comparison, leaving a stated historical-source risk.
title: Twisted squares exhaust symmetric lattice-reduced-complete quadrilaterals
